segments.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
“If one ventures a word with you, will you be wearied? Yet who can keep from speaking?
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Surely you have instructed many, and have strengthened their feeble hands.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Your words have steadied those who stumbled; you have braced the knees that were buckling.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: But now trouble has come upon you, and you are weary. It strikes you, and you are dismayed.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Is your reverence not your confidence, and the uprightness of your ways your hope?
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text:
Consider now, I plead:
Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Or where have the upright been destroyed?
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: As I have observed, those who plow iniquity and those who sow trouble reap the same.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: By the breath of God they perish, and by the blast of His anger they are consumed.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: The lion may roar, and the fierce lion may growl, yet the teeth of the young lions are broken.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: The old lion perishes for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Now a word came to me secretly; my ears caught a whisper of it.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: In disquieting visions in the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: fear and trembling came over me and made all my bones shudder.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Then a spirit glided past my face, and the hair on my body bristled.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: It stood still, but I could not discern its appearance; a form loomed before my eyes, and I heard a whispering voice:
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God, or a man more pure than his Maker?
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: If God puts no trust in His servants, and He charges His angels with error,
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text:
how much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust,
who can be crushed like a moth!
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: They are smashed to pieces from dawn to dusk; unnoticed, they perish forever.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Are not their tent cords pulled up, so that they die without wisdom?’
segments.speaker: Eliphaz
